_comment: Recipe for volatile remote document corpora synced by `make docs-refresh` (jarvisrag.docsync). The document LIST (names + URLs) is committed here; the downloaded files and per-file fetch state (.docsync_state.json) stay LOCAL/gitignored under each set's corpus_dir. A refresh rewrites a file only when its content actually changed (sha256), so the index manifest + delta-sync re-embed just the changed chunks into Milvus. Production promotion (indexing corpus_dir into jarvis_context) is a separate, gated step.

sets._note: US federal retirement-benefit rules (OPM CSRS/FERS Handbook + SSA pubs). Volatile: updated on policy/administration changes. Complements the eCFR MCP connector (which serves live Title-5 CFR text) with plain-language computation guidance.
